standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Jul 17 to Sep 9 (+71%, wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+8.6% to −1.6%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the Nov 4, 2025 low and the 61.8% retracement of the Jul 17–Sep 9 rise in the same place. material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the average price paid since the Jul 28 high, the 50% retracement of the Jul 28–Oct 5 drop and the open gap of Oct 15, where 5 levels of 4 kinds meet.

material.head: A lower high and a lower low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.

material.head: A failed breakout from a 5-week base
material.text: It closed above the top of a 5-week base but has fallen back inside: a failed breakout. 1 of the 2 closes from the break on held above the level it broke, and the break session closed 0.6 ATR past it on a 1.3-ATR range.

material.head: Support −1% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −1% below (0.5 ATR), where 13 levels of 4 kinds meet: the January breakout level, the 50-week average and the average price paid since the Oct 5 low.

fear.label: Fear day: Fri Oct 23
fear.text: Fri Oct 23: SPY and SYY both closed red, the kind of day the desk's fear-day rule buys.
